description: This file implements a React component for a Tic Tac Toe game. It includes game logic, state management, UI rendering, and styling for the webpage UI.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Calculates and returns the winner of the current game board, along with the winning line coordinates.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component rendering the Tic Tac Toe game, managing game state, handling user interactions, and UI presentation.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles a user's click on a board cell, updating game state if the cell is empty and the game is ongoing.

methods.name: softReset
methods.description: Resets the game board to initial state, keeping the current scores.

methods.name: hardReset
methods.description: Resets the game board and all scores to initial state.
